messages.subject: compare CLPM between groups
parts:
I am planning a CLPM analysis with two measurement points and two variables. The point is to estimate the reciprocal effects of substance use and impulsivity. I am hypothesizing that stimulant use influences impulsivity more strongly than other substances. So there will be seperate models for two groups: stimulant users vs other drug users. Is there a way to test for significant diference of the cross-lagged path coefficients between the two groups/models?

Thanks a lot in advance :)

messages.author: a637128bbc00102d
messages.subject: Re: compare CLPM between groups
parts: I would do a multigroup CLPM and then constrain the cross-coupling parameters of interest to be equal in the two groups, and then do chi-squared tests comparing model fit of constrained and unconstrained models, and see if there is a significant difference.
